scientific_scope_status: For one fixed memoryless CPTP N:k->D, suppose some recovery has Bell fidelity>=1-kappa and actual mean N(I/k) has tail tau after intrinsic index d0. The accepted actual-channel one-batch construction has averaged half-diamond error<=epsilon+k sqrt(4kappa+6tau), including arbitrary payload references. Numeric kappa/tail, exact nearby model, unknown adjoint/environment and smallest-nonzero-eigenvalue are not inputs. They are performance conditions, not verified outputs.
